name: poi-categories
description: OSM tag expression -> ZE0 POI category code. Rules are tried in ascending priority; first match wins. A rule with code null is a known OSM category with no code on the EU 2011 factory card (UNMAPPED). No code is invented: every non-null code is counted >0 in the M4.88 table.
